# Thrussell Outings

Family outing picker for places within ~90 minutes of Catton (YO7 4SQ).

This site is agent-friendly. Prefer JSON APIs over scraping the HTML UI.

## Start here

- API index (live catalogue + docs): `/api`
- OpenAPI: `/api/openapi.json`
- Natural-language ask/suggest: `/api/suggest?q=...`

## Hermes workflow

When a human asks a question or wants a suggestion:

1. `GET /api/suggest?q=<their words>&limit=5`
2. Answer from `suggestions[].activity`, `why`, and `directions`
3. Only call `GET /api/activities/{id}` if you need live weather or a refined what3words pin

Examples:

- `/api/suggest?q=stepping%20stones%20under%2045%20minutes`
- `/api/suggest?q=pushchair%20friendly%20with%20ice%20cream`
- `/api/suggest?q=short%20waterfall%20walk%20free`
- `/api/activities?features=cave,waterfall&maxDrive=60&view=card`
- `/api/activities?q=malham&view=full&limit=5`

## Structured list filters

`GET /api/activities` supports: `q`, `feature`, `features`, `source`, `sources`,
`terrain`, `terrains`, `maxDrive`, `minDrive`, `maxDistanceMiles`, `free`,
`ids`, `sort` (`drive|title|distance|recent`), `limit`, `offset`, `view` (`card|full`).

`view=card` (default) includes postcode, coordinates, parking, cost, terrain, and sourceUrl.
`view=full` also includes `rawFacts` and `lastSyncedAt`.

## Do not

- Browse or scrape the kid card UI for data
- Invent outings — only return activities from these endpoints
- Call `/api/sync` unless explicitly asked to refresh sources
